Fuel Surcharges

This page outlines the surcharges that apply beyond our regular fees relating to fuel. These charges are applied as a percentage, are calculated in AUD and do not include GST. 

Fuel Surcharge

The fuel levy is applied by CouriersPlease for both domestic and international shipments and is effective at the beginning of each month.

Domestic Fuel Levy

Calculated using the Australian Institute of Petroleum (AIP) fuel index.
